newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank plans 11.72 bln yuan rail loans in 97.
newsitem.headline: China bank plans 11.72 bln yuan rail loans in 97.

text.p: China's State Development Bank plans to lend 11.72 billion yuan ($1.41 billion) for important railway construction projects in 1997, the China Daily said on Wednesday.

The development bank, a policy bank set up to support infrastructure development, has already extended 2.226 billion yuan in loans for railway construction in the first quarter of the year, officials newspapers have said.
The first quarter loans brought the total granted by the bank to 49 railway projects to 32.8 billion yuan, the China Daily said.
The loans to railway projects accounted for 12 percent of the bank's total loans, it said.
